run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend-proxy since 2026-11-16T15:53:05Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate alert on otel-demo/frontend-proxy is a propagated symptom of the checkout service having no running backend. At 15:53:12–15:53:22Z the checkout Deployment rolled out a new ReplicaSet (checkout-d75b77f99) whose application container image string is malformed — "quay.io/it-bench/hello-bench-arm64\n:1.0.0" contains a literal newline — so the kubelet cannot start the container (InvalidImageName, sequence matches the alert start of 15:53:05Z). The old ReplicaSet checkout-5dccddf8bb was scaled 1→0 and its pod deleted, leaving the Deployment with 1 desired and 0 ready/available replicas, and the checkout Service with zero ready endpoint addresses. checkout span volume drops to zero after ~15:57. Consequently the checkout call path fails: frontend emits STATUS_CODE_ERROR spans on grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder, executing api route (pages) /api/checkout, POST /api/checkout and POST, and frontend-proxy emits errors on its ingress and "router frontend egress" operations, with its access log showing repeated "POST /api/checkout HTTP/1.1" 500 - via_upstream while GET /api/products and /api/recommendations return 200. frontend-proxy error rate rose from a ~0.004–0.019 spans/s baseline before 15:53 to a peak of ~1.5 spans/s at 15:59–16:01 and was still elevated at 16:07. The proxy pod itself is Running, ready, 0 restarts, and its deployment is 1/1 ready, so it is not itself broken. Small pre-existing flagd EventStream error spans in ad/fraud-detection/recommendation predate the incident and are unrelated.

claims.text: frontend-proxy STATUS_CODE_ERROR span rate was ~0.0037–0.0185/s between 15:35 and 15:53, then rose to 0.285 at 15:55, 0.911 at 15:57, peaked at 1.496–1.504 at 15:59–16:01 and was still 0.459/s at 16:07; frontend STATUS_CODE_ERROR spans show the same onset (0 through 15:53, 0.589 at 15:55, 1.796 at 15:57, ~3.0 at 15:59–16:01).

Over the 60 minutes ending 16:14Z the error spans are concentrated in the checkout path: frontend-proxy span_name "ingress" 373.55 and "router frontend egress" 364.39; frontend span_name "grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder" 361.34, "executing api route (pages) /api/checkout" 361.34, "POST /api/checkout" 361.23, "POST" 361.34 and "tcp.connect" 19.34. Other frontend operations (/api/cart, /api/data, AdService/GetAds, CartService/GetCart, GET) show 0 error spans.
checkout's own span rate collapsed to 0 after the rollout: 9.38/s at 15:53, 3.38/s at 15:55, 0 from 15:57 onward, versus 3.8–10.1/s earlier in the window — checkout stopped producing spans entirely.

Deployment otel-demo/checkout has spec.template.spec.containers[0].image = "quay.io/it-bench/hello-bench-arm64\n:1.0.0" (embedded newline), spec.replicas 1, generation 4, unavailableReplicas 1, and no readyReplicas/availableReplicas reported. Every other deployment in otel-demo, including frontend and frontend-proxy, reports ready 1 and available 1.

Pod checkout-d75b77f99-hgc68 (owner ReplicaSet checkout-d75b77f99) is Pending with podIP 100.96.4.211; its container "checkout" is not ready with waiting reason InvalidImageName and message: Failed to apply default image tag "quay.io/it-bench/hello-bench-arm64\n:1.0.0": couldn't parse image name "quay.io/it-bench/hello-bench-arm64\n:1.0.0": invalid reference format. Its init container uses busybox:latest, so only the application image is malformed.

Rollout events for the Deployment checkout show the switch at 15:53: the old pod checkout-5dccddf8bb-xq5bq was killed at 15:53:15 and checkout-5dccddf8bb scaled 1→0, pods of the new ReplicaSet checkout-d75b77f99 were created at 15:53:12 and 15:53:22, and both new pods logged InspectFailed and "Error: InvalidImageName" warnings (Failed to apply default image tag ... invalid reference format).

ReplicaSet checkout-5dccddf8bb (owner Deployment checkout) now has spec.replicas 0 and checkout-d75b77f99 (owner Deployment checkout) has spec.replicas 1 with no readyReplicas, confirming the ownership chain Deployment checkout → ReplicaSet checkout-d75b77f99 → Pod checkout-d75b77f99-hgc68.

The checkout Service endpoint object has no ready addresses and lists only notReadyAddresses 100.96.4.211 on port 8080 — the pending checkout pod — while the frontend (100.96.4.149) and frontend-proxy (100.96.4.165) Services have ready addresses.

frontend-proxy container logs for 16:00–16:02Z show repeated "POST /api/checkout HTTP/1.1" 500 - via_upstream - ... "frontend" entries, while "GET /api/products/... HTTP/1.1" 200 and "GET /api/recommendations?... HTTP/1.1" 200 succeed through the same proxy, so the 5xx is confined to the checkout route and is generated by the upstream frontend response.

frontend-proxy itself is not broken: pod frontend-proxy-6b4d584985-t9gll is Running, ready, with 0 restarts and no waiting/terminated state, its Deployment reports 1/1 ready and available, and its own container is serving successful 200 responses on non-checkout routes. Its error rate is a downstream consequence, not a fault in the proxy.

The flagd EventStream error spans attributed to ad, fraud-detection and recommendation are not the cause of this alert: their error rates were already present before 15:53 at roughly 0.0018/s (ad and recommendation non-zero from ~15:35–15:40, fraud-detection appearing later) and stayed at that same tiny level through 16:10, i.e. they are small pre-existing stream errors unrelated to the checkout outage.

The drop in frontend/frontend-proxy span volume at 16:05–16:07 is not a recovery: error share stayed roughly constant (frontend 2.87 errors of 52.34 spans-per-second at 16:03 versus 0.878 of 15.68 at 16:07; frontend-proxy 1.45 of 24.40 at 16:03 versus 0.459 of 7.04 at 16:07), so both traffic and failures fell together while checkout remained at 0 spans.

The mechanism between the malformed checkout image and the proxy alert is: checkout has no ready endpoint, frontend's gRPC PlaceOrder to checkout fails, frontend's /api/checkout route returns 500, and frontend-proxy records that 500 on ingress and on "router frontend egress". The endpoint gap, the checkout span collapse, the frontend PlaceOrder error spans and the proxy's 500 log lines all line up, but the exact gRPC failure text from frontend could not be read (no frontend log lines and no Jaeger traces returned).

Correct Deployment otel-demo/checkout's container image to a valid reference (the malformed value contains a trailing newline before the tag, e.g. "quay.io/it-bench/hello-bench-arm64\n:1.0.0", which the kubelet rejects as invalid reference format), or roll back to ReplicaSet checkout-5dccddf8bb, then verify pod checkout-d75b77f99-* reaches Running/Ready, the checkout Service endpoint list gains a ready address, and frontend-proxy's /api/checkout 500s stop.

gaps: Frontend application logs could not be read: fetch_pod_logs on frontend-675fd7b5c5-pr589 returned 0 lines read for 15:55–16:10Z, so the exact gRPC error text returned by the checkout call is unverified.

Jaeger returned no traces for frontend-proxy (15:55–16:10Z and 16:08–16:14Z) and none for frontend grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder with error=true, although traces_list_operations shows frontend-proxy operations "ingress" and "router frontend egress"; trace-level status and parent-child edges for the failing checkout calls were therefore not observed (a sampled/retention view, not proof of absence).

kube-state-metrics series kube_deployment_status_replicas_available / kube_deployment_status_replicas_ready returned no data at 16:14Z and no kube_deployment_status.* metric names were listed for 15:40–16:14Z, so deployment replica status was taken from the Kubernetes API objects instead; the kube-state series values are unknown, not zero.
The Prometheus rules load contains no rule named RequestErrorRate (list_prometheus_rules returned nothing), so the alert's exact PromQL, threshold and evaluation window could not be confirmed.

Change history is not an integrated data source in this Run, so who applied the checkout image change and whether the embedded newline came from templating or a manual edit is unknown; only its effect is observed.

frontend-proxy logs were read only for the newest matching 60 of 627 lines (16:00:31–16:01:58Z); the earliest post-rollout proxy log lines (15:53–16:00Z) were not read, so the first observed proxy 500 timestamp is later than the actual onset.
next_steps: Fix or roll back the otel-demo/checkout Deployment image (strip the embedded newline / use a valid tag such as the pinned demo checkout image) and confirm the new pod becomes Ready and the Service endpoint becomes ready.

Confirm post-fix that frontend-proxy logs stop emitting "POST /api/checkout" 500 - via_upstream and that frontend's grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder spans return STATUS_CODE_OK, then close the RequestErrorRate alert.
Add an admission or CI validation that rejects container image strings failing reference-format parsing (e.g. trailing/embedded whitespace) so a bad tag cannot complete a rollout.
If root-cause attribution of the change is needed, review the deployment/change pipeline outside this Run, since change history is not integrated.
